column1: # Seed photographs — where every file under db/seeds/media/<category>/ came from.
# All are free photos from Unsplash (https://unsplash.com/license): free to use commercially and
# non-commercially, no permission needed. Unsplash+ (premium) images are deliberately excluded.
# tools/fetch-seed-media.sh reads this file and downloads anything missing as
# <category>/<pool>-NN.jpg, NN counting from 01 in the order listed within each pool.
